# Longwave Technologies

> Longwave Technologies sells, leases, and repairs new and affordable used (refurbished) black & white and color copiers and multifunction printers for small and medium-sized businesses in New York City, Long Island, and Westchester. We also supply toner and copier parts. Family business serving the Tri-State area since 1991.

- Phone: (516) 663-0968
- Email: longwavetechinfo@gmail.com
- Location: Hempstead, NY, 11550
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm
- Service area: Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, The Bronx, Staten Island, Nassau County, Suffolk County, Westchester County
- In business since: 1991
- Brands we sell and service: Kyocera, Sharp, Konica Minolta, Toshiba, Canon, Ricoh, Xerox, HP, Brother, NEC

## Services

- Copier sales (new and used): New and affordable used (refurbished) black & white and color copiers and multifunction printers (MFPs) that print, copy, scan, and fax.
- Copier leasing and rentals: Copier leases and flexible equipment rental agreements, so you don't have to pay the full price up front.
- Copier repair and maintenance: On-site copier and printer repair, remote troubleshooting, and maintenance-only service contracts for Kyocera, Sharp, Konica Minolta, Toshiba, Canon, Ricoh, Xerox, HP, and more.
- Toner and copier supplies: Original and compatible (generic) toner cartridges, parts, and supplies.
- Delivery, installation, and setup: Delivery and installation across the Tri-State area, plus network, printer, and scanner setup for Windows and Mac.

## Frequently asked questions

### Do you sell used copiers?

Yes. Alongside new machines, we sell affordable used (refurbished) black & white and color copiers from Kyocera, Sharp, Konica Minolta, Toshiba, and Canon. Refurbished copiers are a good fit for small businesses that want a reliable office copier on a budget.

### Can I lease a copier instead of buying one?

Yes. We offer copier leases and flexible rental agreements for both new and used machines. Call (516) 663-0968 or use our contact form for a quote.

### Which copier brands do you repair?

We repair and maintain Kyocera, Sharp, Konica Minolta, Toshiba, Canon, Ricoh, Xerox, HP, Brother, and NEC copiers and printers, with on-site repairs, remote troubleshooting, and maintenance-only service contracts.

### Do you sell toner and copier supplies?

Yes. We supply original and compatible (generic) toner cartridges and parts for the copiers we sell and service.

### What areas do you serve?

We serve businesses in all five NYC boroughs (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, and Staten Island), Long Island (Nassau and Suffolk counties), and Westchester County, with delivery and installation included.

### How long has Longwave Technologies been in business?

Since 1991. We started out repairing copiers for local businesses and have served many of our clients for over 20 years.

### How do I get a quote?

Call (516) 663-0968, email longwavetechinfo@gmail.com, or fill out the form on our contact page.
